events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Woodstock Festival of Music & Art, which took place over three days in August 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the legendary Woodstock Festival. What's your favourite moment from the summer of '69?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley, gone but never forgotten. Which of his hits is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Remembering the tragic death of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas in 1996 and died six days later at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a true music legend. Tupac Shakur's impact on hip-hop and culture remains immense. What's his most important track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic album cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us Abbey Road. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are unmistakable. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger. What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's timeless message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song with a message that resonates as strongly today as it did then.

events.title: iPod's 25th anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: The original MP3 player
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed everything. Remember trying to fit your entire CD collection on one device?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and which theme tune is the ultimate?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. He was born in 1940 and tragically passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today. He was born in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy icon birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album's impact
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Queen legend tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence were truly legendary. What's your favourite Queen song?
